label: Immanent operation: Operates x, x has an operation that remains in the agent
term: having an immanent operation (the primitive Operates of SelfOperationLife)
definition: Operates x: x has an immanent operation, one that remains in the agent and perfects it rather than passing into another (actio quae manet in agente, ST I q.18 a.3 ad 1), such as understanding or willing. Explicitly identified PRIMITIVE: in Lean a parameter B -> Prop of SelfOperatingUnmovedLives, PureActOperates and NineOperate, constrained only by the open premises that use it. It does not include being unmoved: that condition is the separate conjunct (forall r, not MovedIn x r) of STMT-SELF-OPERATING-UNMOVED-LIVES. Example: a human understanding (an immanent operation of something that is moved from potency to act in understanding). Non-example: a stone resting; fire heating wood (transient). Distinguishing conditions: (1) not LIVING_1 (f91f5056, the timeless primitive Primitives.Lives) and not DEF-LIVING (b89f3234, operating from oneself and not as moved by another): those include not being moved by another, while Operates holds of a human understanding, which is moved from potency to act; Operates and Lives are distinct predicates and nothing identifies them; (2) narrower than DEF-OPERATING-AGENT (1c062aa6, some activity, transient or immanent), which shares the Lean parameter name Operates in other modules; (3) not time-indexed, unlike DEF-OPERATES-FROM-ITSELF-AT; (4) not motion (DISAMB-MOTION).
note: Stipulative analyst notion, attribution deferred; motivated by ST I q.18 a.3 (claim 611be1f0), which is not read as stating it. Near-definitional link, stated plainly: on the q.18 a.3 gloss recorded in DEF-LIVING (things live insofar as they operate from themselves, not as moved by others), 'has an immanent operation and is moved in no respect' is close to the definiens of living. So the premise 'whatever has the nine operates' carries most of the content of the living conjunct the route derives, and an audit of its warrant is largely an audit of that conjunct; what the route adds is the separate unmovedness step (from pure act and the Prima Via motion premise) and the sense bridge. The two senses of 'operating' (this one and DEF-OPERATING-AGENT) have no disambiguation record yet: this sense has no Lean declaration of its own (Operates is a parameter), so a sense-indexed OPERATING disambiguation is deferred to #216. Open semantic obligations: a typed account of immanent operation (for example an intellect or will in act with no potency, q.18 a.3 ad 1-2) under which the operation premises could be derived or fail; and how an immanent operation without succession relates to OperatesFromItselfAt in a duration frame (the timeless-agency literature, unread, bears on exactly this).
